run_generate_changelog: run the script with a previous release tag to generate per-language changelog entries
review_Language_class: review the Language class that stores a language name and its git pathspec list
refactor_language_list: refactor the languages list to add or remove language-specific git pathspecs for changelog generation
test_changelog_output: test the changelog script by passing a git tag and verifying per-language commit output
summarize_git_log_command: summarize how the script uses git log with pathspecs to filter commits per language
